title: bug(plugin-detail): `record:details`' dedupe hides the WRONG row when the object declares a `nameField` the literal walk does not know
body:
Surfaced while implementing objectui#7586 (removing the `primaryField` rung from this same ladder). ⛔ Not caused by that change — measured as byte-identical before and after it, because the rung it removes was never populated. Filed separately rather than folded in: #7586's fence is "remove the undeclared read", and this is an ADDITION to the ladder, a different repair on the same lines.

⛔ Not claimed, not graded.

## The two halves disagree

`record:details` drops from the body grid the one field whose value the page H1 already shows, so a record page does not print `客户名称: Acme Corporation` directly under an H1 reading `Acme Corporation`. It picks that field with a literal walk:

```
packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx
  const titleCandidates = ['name', 'full_name', 'title', 'subject', 'display_name', 'label'];
  // first candidate whose value on the record is non-empty wins
```

The H1 is drawn a package away, by `PageHeaderRenderer` in `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, whose chain runs `schema.title` then `titleFormat` then the unified ADR-0079 resolver (`nameField` then `displayNameField` then type-aware derivation) and only THEN the same literal walk.

The resolver rung is the one the ladder has no equivalent of. So for an object whose declared `nameField` points at a field the literal walk does not know:

| | H1 shows | grid hides | grid still shows |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `nameField: 'contract_no'`, record has `contract_no` and `name` | `contract_no`'s value | `name` — a row the H1 never showed | `contract_no` — the row the H1 IS showing |

Both halves of the dedupe are wrong at once: the duplicate survives, and an ordinary field disappears instead.

## Measured, not inferred

The H1 half is already pinned green on `origin/main` — `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-title.test.tsx`, the case `nameField wins over a record-level 'name' value`, asserts the heading is `HT-2026-001` for a record carrying `name: 'internal-name'`. The ladder half is a six-entry literal list with no resolver call in it; `name` is its first entry and the record has a value there.

## Suggested shape

Ask `@object-ui/core`'s `resolveNameField` first, then fall through to the literal walk — the same delegation objectui#7287 / PR #7585 made in `resolveTitleField` and objectui#7586 made in the header chain. Then the ladder's docstring claim (it mirrors the tail of the chip's chain) becomes true of the whole chain rather than its tail.

Whoever takes it: the pin must assert the DEDUPE outcome, which row the grid renders and which it drops, not the title. A title-only pin passes while this stays wrong — the two are decided in different packages. `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-details.primaryFieldRetired-7586.test.tsx` is the harness shape for that.

Related: objectui#7586 (the removal that put these lines under a microscope) · objectui#7287 / PR #7585 · ADR-0079.
